title: InteroperabilityReport
description: Behavioural interoperability result for an implementation against a profile (ADR-032). Records the happy-path and NEGATIVE scenarios (malformed, invalid signature, timeout, retry, duplicate, replay, idempotency, unsupported capability, profile/protocol mismatch, stale metadata, expired evidence, revoked, reversal, refund, reconciliation, partial failure), with a reproducible evidence_hash. Certification requires interoperability AND conformance — never schema conformance alone (ADR-032). A PASS is technical evidence, not a licence/admission/authorisation (ADR-005).
_authority: ADR-032 (interoperability certification); this schema and the conformance/ interoperability vectors define the report. engines/banza-certification implements it and does not define it.
